A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] was the '''younger brother''' of another [[Unidentified older brother|Human male]].<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]'' to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].</ref> the pair lived in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After offending the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]], she [[Telekinesis/Legends|threw]] the younger brother at a predatory [[radank]], and the older brother followed to try to defend his sibling.<ref name="Tempest" />
